name: softicon-poll
description: Poll and survey block for the WordPress block editor, votes stay on your own site

scripts.zip:
rm -f softicon-poll.zip && printf '→ Building block
' && (npm run -s build >/dev/null 2>&1 || npm run build) && printf '→ Translations
' && (npm run -s i18n-pot >/dev/null 2>&1 || npm run i18n-pot) && npm run -s find-ds && printf '→ Zipping
' && cd .. && zip -rq softicon-poll/softicon-poll.zip softicon-poll/softicon-poll.php softicon-poll/uninstall.php softicon-poll/index.php softicon-poll/includes softicon-poll/src softicon-poll/build softicon-poll/languages softicon-poll/readme.txt softicon-poll/package.json softicon-poll/webpack.config.js -x '*/.DS_Store' '*.map'
scripts.postzip:
printf '
✔ Zip ready: %s
  %s files, %s

' "$PWD/softicon-poll.zip" "$(unzip -l softicon-poll.zip | tail -1 | awk '{print $2}')" "$(du -h softicon-poll.zip | cut -f1 | tr -d ' ')"
scripts.bundle: npm run lint && npm run zip
